items.title: Ansible For DevOps
items.description: This repository contains Ansible examples developed to support different sections of by Jeff Geerling, which is listed in the following section of books about Ansible.

items.title: Ansible Tutorial by leucos
items.description: 12 Step Tutorial for Ansible.

items.title: AWX
items.description: Web-based user interface, REST API, and task engine built on top of Ansible. It is the upstream project for Automation Controller.

items.title: Ansible Semaphore
items.description: Modern UI for managing and running Ansible playbooks.

items.title: Ansible Lint
items.description: Checks Playbooks for best practices and behavior that could potentially be improved.

items.title: kics
items.description: SAST Tool that scans your Ansible infrastructure as code playbooks for security vulnerabilities, compliance issues and misconfigurations.

items.title: Ansible cmdb
items.description: Takes the output of Ansible's fact gathering and converts it into a static HTML page.

items.title: ARA
items.description: Records Ansible playbooks and makes them easier to understand and troubleshoot with a reporting API, UI and CLI.

items.title: ansible-runner
items.description: A tool and Python library that helps when interfacing with Ansible directly or as part of another system whether that be through a container image interface, as a standalone tool, or as a Python module that can be imported.

items.title: Ansible Playbook Grapher
items.description: Command line tool to create a graph representing your Ansible playbook plays, tasks and roles.

items.title: ansible-navigator
items.description: A text-based user interface (TUI) for Ansible.

items.title: Ansible Inventory Grapher
items.description: Displays inventory inheritance hierarchies and the level at which variables are defined in an inventory.

items.title: terraform.py
items.description: Ansible dynamic inventory script for parsing Terraform state files.

items.title: TD4A
items.description: Design aid for building and testing jinja2 templates, combines data in yaml format with a jinja2 template and render the output.

items.title: php-ansible Library
items.description: OOP-Wrapper for Ansible, making Ansible available in PHP.

items.title: Ansible Doctor
items.description: Simple annotation like documentation generator for Ansible roles based on Jinja2 templates.

items.title: Excel Ansible Inventory
items.description: Turn any Excel Spreadsheet into an Ansible Inventory.

items.title: aar-doc - Automated Ansible Role Documentation
items.description: Generate documentation automatically from an Ansible role's metadata.

items.title: ansibledb
items.description: Flask API Web server that uses MongoDB as database to store Ansible reports and facts; this tool can be used to query hosts and facters managed Ansible as well search Ansible logs.

items.title: Ansible DocSmith
items.description: Generates Ansible role documentation from argument_specs.yml for READMEs and default variable files.

items.title: ansible-doc-extractor
items.description: A tool that extracts documentation from Ansible modules in the HTML form.

items.title: ansible-security-scanner
items.description: Static analyzer for playbooks, roles and collections covering hardcoded credentials, RCE, and supply-chain risks. Outputs SARIF, CycloneDX SBOM and GitLab SAST.

items.title: antsichaut
items.description: Automate the filling of a changelog.yaml used by antsibull-changelog.

items.title: Testing Ansible Roles Against Windows with Test-Kitchen
items.description: Using Test-Kitchen with Ansible to apply playbooks to Windows machines and test them with Pester.

items.title: Enhancing Ansible Development with SOLID Principles
items.description: Discover how the fundamental principles of SOLID—Single Responsibility, Open-Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion—can significantly elevate your Ansible role and playbook development.

items.title: Ansible Vagrant Examples by geerlingguy
items.description: Ansible examples using Vagrant to deploy to local VMs.

items.title: Openstack Ansible
items.description: Ansible Playbooks for deploying OpenStack.

items.title: T.A.D.S. boilerplate
items.description: Provision and deploy a Docker Swarm cluster to development environment and to production. Infrastructure as Code and DevOps best practices.

items.title: BlueBanquise
items.description: An Ansible coherent roles collection to deploy clusters.

items.title: Ansible playbook for Linux machine setup
items.description: Ansible playbook for setting up a self-updating, hardened Debian/Ubuntu machine with Docker daemon.

items.title: Linuxfabrik LFOps
items.description: An Ansible Collection with 145+ playbooks and 160+ roles to bootstrap and manage Linux infrastructure (RHEL 8/9/10, Debian, Ubuntu). Covers OS hardening, MariaDB, Icinga2, Nextcloud, FreeIPA, KVM and Bitwarden integration.

items.title: ansible-ssm
items.description: An Ansible role to provision physical and virtual hosts with the AWS SSM agent.
